body:
I’ll be doing afternoon and evening events in your fair cities in less than two weeks!

Each evening at 7:30 pm, I’ll be talking about The Great Spiritual Migration (my new book) and what it means for you in your spiritual and congregational life. Books will be available for purchase and we’ll also have some free gifts for all who attend. There is no charge for this evening event.

In the afternoons from 1:00-4:30, I’ll be meeting with pastors, priests, lay leaders, and seminarians (and other interested people) to talk in more depth about the way forward for just and generous Christian faith.

 It’s ideal if you can bring a group from your congregation, which is why the cost is $50 per person for groups of 10 or more, $60 per person for groups of 4-9, and $99 per individual.

 The first 24 people to register in each city will have a free copy of my new book waiting for them, and everyone present will receive a bunch of free resources (valued at more than the registration fee). If you want to come but can’t afford registration, we have scholarships available (just email info@/archive/brian-mclaren).

More information is available here:

 Encino/LA area: Friday, September 23

 San Diego: Saturday-Sunday, September 24-25
